title: Accounting
subtitle: Provisional chart of accounts, pending the accountant's approval
provisional: This chart of accounts and the account used for each event are provisional. They can still be changed until ARTÉPOOL's accountant approves them; the system goes live only after that approval. Every change is written to the audit log for the accountant to review.

chart.deactivateNote: Accounts are never deleted: their history must be kept. A deactivated account receives no new postings; you can reactivate it later.
chart.empty: The chart of accounts is empty.
chart.lockedWhy: This account is in use ({reason}), so its type, header choice, control flag and active state cannot change. Its code, names, the header it sits under and the contra flag can still change.

inUse.business_line: Used by a line of business

field.isHeaderHint: Groups other accounts and never receives postings itself.
field.isControlHint: Its balance is the total of a sub-ledger (e.g. all customers); only automatic postings use it.
field.isContraHint: Reduces its group's balance (e.g. accumulated depreciation).

links.help: Each event below posts automatically to the account chosen here. Only suitable accounts are offered: active, receiving postings, of the type shown, and a control account only where one is needed.
links.readOnly: Each event below posts automatically to the account shown. Only people allowed to manage the chart of accounts can change them.

ar_control.title: Customer receivables
ar_control.body: Every customer posting: invoices, payments, credit notes and refunds.

ap_control.title: Supplier payables
ap_control.body: Every supplier posting (purchases arrive in Phase 2).

customer_advances.title: Customer advances
customer_advances.body: The net amount of advance and progress payments, until the final invoice deducts them.

vat_output.title: VAT payable on sales
vat_output.body: The VAT on every tax invoice, and its reversal on credit notes.

vat_input.title: VAT recoverable on purchases
vat_input.body: The VAT paid on purchases and expenses (Phase 2).

inventory.title: Inventory – sellable
inventory.body: The value of stock for sale: goods sold leave at cost; returns and counts add or remove value.

inventory_defective.title: Inventory – defective
inventory_defective.body: Broken returns, held at cost until they are written off.

stock_adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
stock_adjustments.body: Gains and losses from stock counts, adjustments and approved overselling at the POS.

write_off.title: Defective stock write-offs
write_off.body: The cost of defective goods that are written off.

cash_over_short.title: Cash over / short
cash_over_short.body: The difference found when a cashier's shift is closed.

cash_in_safe.title: Cash in safe
cash_in_safe.body: Cash dropped from the drawers into the safe, and float taken from it.

opening_balance_equity.title: Opening balances
opening_balance_equity.body: The other side of the opening customer balances and opening stock at go-live.

period.invalid: Choose a start and an end date; the start cannot be after the end.

journal.empty: No entries match in this period.

trial.empty: No account moved in this period.
